_comment: §14/§26: Crystals are the premium currency, spent on Essence, gate tickets, and cosmetics -- 'buys build/pace, never hunter level'. The source names WHAT Crystals buy but gives zero prices anywhere. Every crystal_cost below is invented v0, not sourced from the design bible: bundle costs scale roughly with what they grant (bigger grant = proportionally pricier, not a flat per-unit rate, so bigger bundles are a modest discount -- standard shop-bundle shape), and cosmetics are priced near the middle Essence bundle since they're pure vanity with no power value. All tunable.

cosmetics.name: Frost Aura
cosmetics.description: A wisp of cyan frost trails the hunter. Purely cosmetic -- no combat effect. (Placeholder-art era: ownership tracked now, visual swap-in comes with the real art pass, §9b/§23.)
